definitions.explanation: The position of lying with one's face and front of body facing upward.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}を{見|み}ながら{仰向|あおむ}けになった。
examples.english: I lay on my back looking at the sky.

examples.japanese: {仰向|あおむ}けの{姿勢|しせい}でストレッチをする。
examples.english: To stretch in a supine position.

notes:
{仰向|あおむ}け describes the supine position with face up. It contrasts with {俯|うつぶ}せ (face down).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仰向|あおむ}けになる: to lie on one's back
- {仰向|あおむ}けに{寝|ね}る: to sleep on one's back
- {仰向|あおむ}けに{倒|たお}れる: to fall backward

KANJI NOTE:
The reading combines {仰|あお} (to look up) and {向|む}け (facing).
